areaNames.A: Kamloops, North Thompson, Bonaparte, Shuswap west
areaNames.B: Mission, Fraser Valley, Harrison, Hope, Fraser Canyon
areaNames.E: Cariboo south: 100 Mile House to Williams Lake

layers.label: Private land
layers.about: Private parcels, merged into blocks. You need the owner's permission to hunt here. Owner names are not open data in BC. Not every parcel is fenced or signed.

layers.label: Parks and protected areas
layers.about: Provincial parks, ecological reserves and protected areas. Hunting rules differ by park.

layers.label: Reserves
layers.about: First Nations reserves. Hunting needs permission from the Nation.

layers.label: City and town limits
layers.about: Cities, towns and villages. Most ban shooting inside their limits by bylaw. Check the local bylaw.

layers.label: Wildlife Management Areas
layers.about: Crown land set aside for wildlife. Hunting is often allowed, but some have their own rules. Read the area notes.

layers.label: Management Units
layers.about: Seasons and limits are set by MU (Management Unit). Check the unit before you hunt.

layers.label: Management Unit numbers
layers.about: Unit numbers like 3-27.

layers.label: Limited Entry Hunting zones
layers.about: Zones where some seasons need a Limited Entry Hunting draw permit. Zones overlap by species.

layers.label: Motor vehicle closures
layers.about: Motor Vehicle Closed Areas and ATV (all terrain vehicle) closures from the hunting synopsis maps.

layers.label: Routes in closures
layers.about: Roads open or closed to motor vehicles inside closures.

layers.label: Forest Service roads
layers.about: Resource roads on the forest tenure list. A road on the map can be gated, washed out or deactivated.

layers.label: Recreation sites
layers.about: Free or low cost campsites run by Recreation Sites and Trails BC.

layers.label: Recreation trails
layers.about: Official trails from Recreation Sites and Trails BC.

layers.label: Mule deer winter range
layers.about: Official ungulate winter range. Deer gather here from about November to April. None is mapped near Heffley Creek.

layers.label: White tailed deer winter range
layers.about: Official white tailed deer winter range.

layers.label: Moose winter range
layers.about: Official moose winter range.

layers.label: Elk winter range
layers.about: Official elk winter range.

layers.label: Bighorn sheep winter range
layers.about: Official bighorn sheep winter range.

layers.label: Mountain goat winter range
layers.about: Ungulate winter range for mountain goats, set by government order.

layers.label: Burns by year
layers.about: Fires since 2000. Burns 3 to 15 years old grow food for deer, moose and bears.

layers.label: Cutblocks by age
layers.about: Logged openings 25 years old or less. Blocks 5 to 20 years old feed deer, moose, bears and grouse.

layers.label: Wetlands
layers.about: Marshes, swamps and bogs from the Freshwater Atlas. Good for moose and ducks.

layers.label: Habitat zones
layers.about: Biogeoclimatic zones: the plant community you will find. Bunchgrass and Ponderosa Pine are low winter country.

layers.label: Mule deer by month (general pattern)
layers.source: data/migration.json (cited studies) with BEC zones and elevation (terrarium tiles)
layers.about: Where mule deer tend to be by month: habitat zones and elevation bands from studies. General pattern, not mapped corridors. Use the month slider.

layers.label: Duck staging and winter waters
layers.source: FWA lakes, wetlands and rivers with data/migration.json flyway timing
layers.about: Valley lakes and wetlands of 20 ha or more where ducks stop in fall and spring, and low open water in winter. General pattern.

layers.label: California quail habitat (no migration)
layers.source: BEC zones and elevation with data/migration.json
layers.about: Quail do not migrate. Low Bunchgrass and Ponderosa Pine country near farms and brushy creeks, all year. General pattern.

layers.label: Candidate spots
layers.source: Hunt Mentor spot pipeline (scripts/spots-pipeline.py) from BC Data Catalogue layers
layers.about: Candidate spots scored from open data (my pick): drive, ATV (all terrain vehicle), walk, backcountry and camp. Busier and quieter are estimates. Candidate, scout it first.

layers.label: Walk and ride routes
layers.source: Hunt Mentor spot pipeline (road atlas, forest roads, rec trails)
layers.about: Suggested approach lines (estimate).

layers.label: Camps (rec sites and candidates)
layers.source: FTEN_REC_SITE_POINTS_SVW plus Crown land camp candidates (Hunt Mentor spot pipeline)
layers.about: Official rec sites and Crown land camp candidates (flat, near water, not private, park or reserve). Scout it first.
